metadata.short_desc: Uses an independent LLM to stop only naturally completed exchanges.
metadata.desc: Silently stops the default reply only for a high-confidence closed exchange. Uncertain results and model failures continue normally.

basic_settings.hint: Choose whether the plugin is enabled and where it is used.

enabled.hint: When disabled, the plugin does not read conversations, call the decision model, or intercept messages.

judgement_settings.hint: Select the model that decides whether a conversation is complete.

judge_provider_id.hint: Choose an existing AstrBot model. Messages continue normally when it is missing or unavailable.

confidence_threshold.hint: Higher values are more cautious. This is not a random reply probability.

context_settings.hint: Control how much recent context is used and how long it stays in memory.

advanced_settings.hint: Controls model usage and diagnostics. Most users do not need to change these settings.
